candidate_prompt.title: Candidate Prompt

draw_key.description: The corpus vintage the draw order is keyed by

BacktestComparisonMoment.description: The paired figures at one prediction moment.

after_both_cutoffs.description: The drawn-set figure over the pairs decided after both arms' training cutoffs only, unweighted, so it describes those drawn cases and not a population: the subset where recall of the outcome is least likely, a stated cutoff being a month and approximate. Null where a cutoff is not recorded; `pairs` is 0 where the cutoffs are recorded and no such case was drawn

by_stratum.description: The paired difference within each stratum that holds a pair: what `population` is built from, and the reading to use where its interval is null
by_stratum.title: By Stratum

cells.description: Cells provisioned at this moment, per arm
cells.title: Cells

drawn_set.description: Every pair counted once: the difference on the set as drawn

population.description: The strata reweighted to their population shares; null under an unstratified draw, whose drawn-set figure already estimates its population, and null where a weighted stratum holds no pair

BacktestComparisonMoment.title: BacktestComparisonMoment

BacktestComparisonPair.description: One replayed cell under both arms: the same case, moment, record and clock.

after_both_cutoffs.description: Whether `decided` falls after both arms' recorded training cutoffs, so neither model can have been trained on the outcome. Null where a cutoff or the decision day is not recorded
after_both_cutoffs.title: After Both Cutoffs

brier_difference.description: Candidate Brier minus incumbent Brier on this cell; negative means the candidate was closer. Null where either arm lost the cell
brier_difference.title: Brier Difference

call.description: Whether the binary call moved between the arms: 'to-correct' the candidate is right where the incumbent was wrong, 'to-wrong' the reverse, 'same' both made the same call. Null where either arm lost the cell
call.title: Call

decided.description: The day the outcome was decided; null where the row has none
decided.title: Decided

moment.description: The prediction moment the cell was replayed at
moment.title: Moment

outcome.description: The realized binary outcome the probability is scored against: granted (cert) or disturbed (merits)
outcome.title: Outcome

provisioning.description: The information-set arm the cell was provisioned under (cert: dated, truncated or blind), identical for both arms; null where the replay records none
provisioning.title: Provisioning

stratum.description: The draw stratum the case was sampled in; null under an unstratified draw
stratum.title: Stratum

drawn.description: Cases actually drawn, short of `target` where the replayable stratum ran out
drawn.title: Drawn

passed_over.description: Cases the walk passed over as unreplayable
passed_over.title: Passed Over

population.description: Eligible cases in this stratum of the drawn-from population, replayable or not
population.title: Population

target.description: Cases the draw rule set out to take here
target.title: Target

weight.description: `population` over the whole eligible population: the share the stratum's mean is weighted by in a 'stratified' figure
weight.title: Weight

BacktestComparisonStratumFigures.description: The paired difference within one draw stratum at one moment.

largest_absolute_difference.description: The largest single move in the stratum. `pairs` cells with no large move cannot exclude a large-move rate up to about 3 / `pairs` in the class they were drawn from
largest_absolute_difference.title: Largest Absolute Difference

mean_brier_difference.description: Mean of the stratum's per-cell differences (candidate minus incumbent)
mean_brier_difference.title: Mean Brier Difference

pairs.description: Pairs in this stratum both arms scored
pairs.title: Pairs

BacktestComparisonStratumFigures.title: BacktestComparisonStratumFigures

BacktestPairedFigures.description: The paired difference between the arms over one set of cells both arms scored.

changed_to_correct.description: Pairs where only the candidate's binary call was right
changed_to_correct.title: Changed To Correct

changed_to_wrong.description: Pairs where only the incumbent's binary call was right
changed_to_wrong.title: Changed To Wrong

degrees_of_freedom.description: The t interval's degrees of freedom: pairs minus one, or the Satterthwaite approximation under 'stratified'
degrees_of_freedom.title: Degrees Of Freedom

estimator.description: 'unweighted': every pair counts once, which describes the drawn set. 'stratified': each stratum's mean weighted by its population share (`strata`), which estimates the drawn-from population
estimator.title: Estimator

interval_high.description: With `interval_low`, the Student-t interval for the mean difference at `level`. A paired interval: it is computed on the per-cell differences, so the case-to-case variation both arms share cancels. Null below two pairs (or, stratified, below two in any weighted stratum), where the differences show no spread, and, stratified, where one stratum's weight exceeds 0.8: that class then supplies nearly all of the variance from a handful of near-constant differences, and the interval would cover far less often than `level` says. The differences are bounded and skewed, so at a small `pairs` the nominal coverage is approximate
interval_high.title: Interval High

mean_brier_difference.description: Mean of the per-cell differences (candidate minus incumbent); negative favours the candidate. Under `estimator` 'stratified' it is the strata means weighted by their population shares
mean_brier_difference.title: Mean Brier Difference

pairs.description: Cells both arms scored: the only set compared
pairs.title: Pairs

description:
A back-test comparison report: one predictor's candidate against its incumbent.

Both arms replay the same drawn cases at the same moments from identically
provisioned records under the same replay clock, so the per-cell difference
isolates the one configuration change under test. Produced by
``fedcourts cert-backtest-compare`` and ``fedcourts merits-backtest-compare``.

exposure_note.description: What the recorded training cutoffs let this report say about outcome recall, in a sentence
exposure_note.title: Exposure Note

pulled_through.description: The corpus vintage the set was drawn from
pulled_through.title: Pulled Through

strata.description: The draw strata; empty under an unstratified draw
strata.title: Strata

stratum.description: Every replayed outcome was public before the run. A comparison is evidence for a re-bless decision between two configurations and is never a claimable performance figure; no cell here counts toward a forward board
stratum.title: Stratum
